pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark-brown regions with softened edge gradients and rounded vertices; patches exhibit high spatial occupancy relative to the interstitial space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored pathways forming a continuous topological grid; junction nodes primarily represent 3-way and 4-way intersections with relatively consistent pixel width across the mid-neck region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated edge against the background sky, appearing as short, dense bristled projections.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A slight depression or flattening of the mane line is visible where the neck transitions toward the lower neck region in the frame.

other_distinctive_markers: A small avian figure is visible on the left edge of the neck; a second giraffe head and ossicone are visible on the far right margin of the image.
